daily.today_energy: Your mind is buzzing with creative electricity today, Gemini. Channel this restless vibe into something tangible—your ideas are actually hitting different right now. Trust the momentum.
daily.love: Vulnerability is your superpower today. Whether you're single or coupled up, letting someone see the real you (messy thoughts and all) creates genuine connection. It's giving authenticity.
daily.career: Your communication skills are leveling up. That project or conversation you've been nervous about? You're more ready than you think. Let your natural curiosity lead the way.
daily.health: Your nervous system is asking for grounding today. Touch grass literally, or find a moment to breathe deeply. Moving your body in a way that feels good (not punishing) will shift your whole vibe.

weekly.love: Someone's noticing the shift in your aura. Whether you're single or coupled, authenticity is magnetic right now. Skip the games, lead with your real self. The universe rewards vulnerability more than you'd think.
weekly.career: Ideas are flowing and your voice hits different this week. Don't shrink back from speaking up in meetings or pitching that thing you've been sitting on. Your perspective brings fresh value. Trust the momentum building.
